en.title: Call Claude from Python in 6 lines

scenes.voiceover: Here's how to call Claude from Python in six lines.
Import the SDK, create a client, send one message, and print the reply.

fields.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
msg = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
    max_tokens=300,
    messages=[{"role": "user",
               "content": "Hi!"}],
)
print(msg.content[0].text)
fields.note: One call: pick a model, cap the length, send your message.
